package_entitlements_value_check.name: package_entitlements_value_check
package_entitlements_value_check.value: ("package_entitlements"."is_unlimited" = true AND "package_entitlements"."numeric_value" IS NULL AND "package_entitlements"."boolean_value" IS NULL) OR ("package_entitlements"."is_unlimited" = false AND num_nonnulls("package_entitlements"."numeric_value", "package_entitlements"."boolean_value") = 1)

offers_coupon_code_unique.name: offers_coupon_code_unique
offers_coupon_code_unique.where: "offers"."coupon_code" IS NOT NULL AND "offers"."deleted_at" IS NULL

offers_discount_value_check.name: offers_discount_value_check
offers_discount_value_check.value: ("offers"."discount_type" = 'percentage' AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" > 0 AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" <= 10000 AND "offers"."fixed_amount_minor" IS NULL) OR ("offers"."discount_type" = 'fixed' AND "offers"."fixed_amount_minor" > 0 AND "offers"."percentage_basis_points" IS NULL)

offers_period_check.name: offers_period_check
offers_period_check.value: "offers"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."ends_at" > "offers"."starts_at"

package_prices_current_public_unique.name: package_prices_current_public_unique
package_prices_current_public_unique.where: "package_prices"."is_active" = true AND "package_prices"."is_public" = true AND "package_prices"."deleted_at" IS NULL

packages_trial_configuration_check.name: packages_trial_configuration_check
packages_trial_configuration_check.value: ("packages"."trial_enabled" = false AND "packages"."trial_duration" IS NULL AND "packages"."trial_duration_unit" IS NULL) OR ("packages"."trial_enabled" = true AND "packages"."trial_duration" > 0 AND "packages"."trial_duration_unit" IS NOT NULL)
